title: AlgoHar

target_user.icp: Russian-speaking CS student or junior developer who understands syntax but struggles to build a mental model of algorithms, prepare for university algorithm courses, competitive programming, or technical interviews.

problem: Static text and code often hide the changing state of an algorithm, so learners memorize recipes without understanding the invariant that makes the solution correct.
outcome: A learner can inspect an algorithm step by step, explain its invariant and complexity, experiment with input data, and follow a structured progression from fundamentals to advanced graph and range-query algorithms.
primary_wedge: A Russian-first visual algorithms course where every core lesson combines an interactive execution trace, intuition, pseudocode and complexity on one screen.

time_to_first_value.result: The learner opens a free visualization, controls it manually and can explain one state transition using the lesson text.

primary_artifact.name: AlgoHar interactive course
primary_artifact.delivery: Browser-based self-serve lessons with a free playground and a paid full curriculum after commercial activation is provisioned.

proof.schema: Attributed visit -> free algorithm opened -> visualization completed -> next lesson or lead -> verified payment -> entitlement activated -> retained learning session

distribution_loop.loop: One algorithm implementation -> indexable explanation page + shareable visual clip + free playground entry -> attributed learner -> lesson completion -> referral/share -> next learner.

founder_content_loop.format: Founder-led short visual explanations and build-in-public posts from real AlgoHar simulations; no fake testimonials, scraped audiences, bought engagement or mass unsolicited DMs.

conversion_event.event: Verified paid Full-course purchase with entitlement activation
conversion_event.route: /pricing -> approved checkout -> payment confirmation -> server-side entitlement

activation.truth_source: Server-visible algorithm_open and visualization_complete aggregate events

retention.truth_source: Authenticated learning-session aggregate after server-side progress is implemented

surfaces.homepage_role: Outcome-first course landing that demonstrates the visual learning method before asking for payment.

requirements: Commercial V2 lives under v2/ and does not silently republish legacy contributors' implementation.
Algorithm simulations use a shared typed step model so new lessons remain consistent and testable.

security_privacy.public_private_boundary: No production credentials, raw payment data or private learner data in Git. Browser progress is local by default; server collection is limited to explicitly defined aggregate events and user-submitted lead data.
security_privacy.secret_scan: Tracked-file secret scan plus environment-only checkout, webhook and analytics credentials before deployment.

delivery.model: Self-serve browser product. Free lessons work without account; paid delivery requires an approved checkout and server-side entitlement before sale.

acceptance.criteria: V2 typecheck, lint and production build pass; at least 20 real interactive simulations exist; free funnel works on mobile and desktop; payment cannot claim success without provider evidence; paid content is protected by server-side entitlement before commercial launch.

operations.rollback: Disable checkout links and paid acquisition immediately if entitlement, payment, privacy or deployment verification regresses.
operations.recovery: Redeploy last verified V2 build, keep free playground available when safe, and restore billing only after payment/entitlement checks pass.

owner_blockers: Resolve and document the canonical local checkout path before registering AlgoHar in the local product-registry path resolver.
Complete IP provenance review of any legacy assets or code before they are copied into V2; keep the commercial deployment V2-only meanwhile.
Provision a real domain with HTTPS and verify the production build visually on mobile and desktop.
Publish real seller/support identity, public offer, refund terms, privacy details and receipt handling for the chosen Russian payment path.
Provision an approved checkout/payment provider and implement server-side paid entitlement before accepting money.
Provision durable analytics/lead sinks and verify the attributed visit-to-payment funnel.

paid_acquisition.reason: No verified paid entitlement, seller/legal surface, production domain, or first organic conversion evidence yet.

unavailable_claims.claim: Paid customers, conversion rate, retention, learning-speed improvement and revenue are unverified until external evidence exists.
